name: advanced-packaging-expert
description: Advanced semiconductor packaging expert covering 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration, TSV and hybrid bonding, ABF and glass substrates, warpage and thermal-stress control, yield and failure analysis, reliability qualification, capacity bottlenecks and domestic equipment/material substitution.

displayDescription.en: Covers 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration, TSV and hybrid bonding, warpage and thermal-stress control, yield and failure analysis, and equipment-material bottlenecks.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖2.5D/3D异构集成、TSV与混合键合工艺、翘曲与热应力管控、良率失效分析及设备材料卡点。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一颗AI加速器的2.5D封装，硅中介层加12层HBM4，CoWoS类方案，帮我把工艺路线、翘曲风险、良率拆解和产能瓶颈一起过一遍。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am designing a 2.5D package for an AI accelerator: silicon interposer with 12 HBM4 stacks in a CoWoS-class scheme. Walk me through process route, warpage risk, yield decomposition and capacity bottlenecks.

quickPrompts.en: I am designing a 2.5D package for an AI accelerator: silicon interposer with 12 HBM4 stacks in a CoWoS-class scheme. Walk me through process route, warpage risk, yield decomposition and capacity bottlenecks.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一颗AI加速器的2.5D封装，硅中介层加12层HBM4，CoWoS类方案，帮我把工艺路线、翘曲风险、良率拆解和产能瓶颈一起过一遍。

quickPrompts.en: Compare the routes for a new product: 2.5D silicon interposer vs RDL interposer vs 3D hybrid bonding. Give me cost, yield, design-rule and supply-chain tradeoffs, and tell me when each one wins.
quickPrompts.zh: 新产品要做路线选型：2.5D硅中介层、RDL中介层、3D混合键合这三条路，请从成本、良率、设计规则和供应链四个维度对比，并说明各自在什么场景胜出。

quickPrompts.en: Our 2.5D package shows 3-4% warpage after molding and fails TCT at cycle 3. Give me a root-cause tree covering CTE mismatch, underfill voids, RDL stress and TSV fatigue, plus the tests that discriminate between them.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的2.5D封装成型后翘曲3~4%，TCT在第3个循环就失效，请给一份根因树，覆盖CTE失配、底填空洞、RDL应力与TSV疲劳，并列出能区分这些假设的验证手段。
